## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit and/or e2e)
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm e2e` pass
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) for user-facing changes
- [ ] Public API changes: TSDoc updated, `pnpm docs:reference` run, the capability page updated and a changeset added
- [ ] `pnpm ppds:conformance` passes (docs structure, metadata, links, generated reference)
- [ ] New behavior is opt-in, or the breaking change is called out
- [ ] Any third-party material has a compatible license and is listed in `NOTICE`
